name: test-hygiene-motivation
body:
source statement (human/user brief): the test suite has no real differentiation between test tiers — tests cross boundaries freely and the suite has become very slow; the tier rules must be DEFINED as durable spec so the suite can be split and future test tasks authored against them. The durable spec is new; no prior statement is reconciled.

PROBLEM: no tier taxonomy existed durably. Plan tasks already carry a `tier` field (unit / int / e2e) and the e2e acceptance tasks already state "opt-in, NOT under the default `cargo test` gate" with a `-short`/opt-in guard — but no durable law defined what the tiers MEAN or where the boundary lies, so tests could be (and were) authored across it.

DECISIONS (all user-chosen):
- unit = exactly 1 unit, everything else faked, no real I/O; integration = 2+ units, everything else faked, no real I/O; e2e = 1+ units, real I/O, effectively isolated.
- The whole unit+integration suite must run FAST — the entire default suite in seconds.
- e2e may be slow and is run ONLY as the final gate; the default gate runs unit+int only.
- BOUNDARY (STRICT, user-chosen): "real I/O" means ANY filesystem access (INCLUDING temp directories), ANY database access (INCLUDING opening a local `db.lbug`), ANY git operation, and ANY process spawn. A unit or integration test must be pure in-memory with fakes for FS/DB/git/process; any test touching a temp dir, writing node files, opening `db.lbug`, running git, or spawning the apg binary is e2e by definition.

Pinned as `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries` (the law) with the requirements under `requirements.requirement.test-hygiene`. e2e inherits `global.constraint.no-real-project-test` (scratch /tmp repo only) — referenced, never duplicated. No plan nodes authored here; the plan-writer owns the split phases.

SCOPE JUDGMENT [autonomous]: authored as requirements + one global law + this note — no domain or solution tier. The taxonomy governs test authoring and gating, not a new code capability, so a drives/realised-by/implemented-by spine would be fabricated (and `implemented-by` would need real code FQNs that do not exist). Consistent with `requirements.requirement.role-minimal-tool-grants`, a requirement that carries no drives edge.

REBASE NOTE: the first authoring attempt was refused by the mutation gate (branch DB stale: recorded `dd753132…` vs HEAD `180c411d…`); the coordinator re-scanned and authoring proceeded unchanged. No content changed.
